'''AR-M33''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|Clone trooper armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name is obviously a reference to the word "army", especially since it sold armor for the army.
